name: r4-q4-lost-reason-blob
description: Fix Q4 (stored-text sweep): store.js isLostRow is r.state === 'FAILED' && LOST_REASONS.includes(r.error), a strict test, so a BLOB error (a Buffer) is never a lost reason. ackPush skips a FAILED candidate that is not lost, and pushSummary and the scheduler status flag count only lost rows. D1's plan pushes fail with CAST('stale_unconfirmed' AS BLOB), D2's with the TEXT reason; a weekday-0 ACK then arrives for each, and the valve list and schedule read report the push states.
